name: Katherine Isabella Pattison
bio: Harry Marillier's first wife, married in 1893 - the daughter of John Pattinson, a Newcastle public analyst. They had two daughters. She died in 1901.
bio_note: Her birth year is not stated in the source read. NOTE THE SPELLING WOBBLE, WHICH IS THE SOURCE'S OWN: the Whistler edition gives the wife as 'Katherine Isabella Pattison' and her father as 'John Pattinson' in a single sentence. Neither spelling is corrected here. The marriage postdates Marillier's 1885-86 correspondence with Wilde - the reason he is on this map - by seven years.
